Our Story

Rooted in Heritage.
Built Through Experience.
Ready to Scale.

Zyzven Naturals was never born from a perfectly written business plan. It grew from my life, my family, my heritage, and the thousands of conversations we had with people asking the same questions I once asked about myself.

I am Shawnafi Dynesen, founder and formulator of Zyzven Naturals. I am a Jamaican Maroon from St. Thomas, Jamaica — an author, a mother, and someone who became deeply interested in botanical wellness because I first needed answers for myself.

My husband, Lawrence Anderson, has been part of this journey from the early days when we physically made and packed products together, through to the international company we are building today. Even our name is personal: Zyzven Naturals was named after the child Lawrence and I share, Týr-Zyzven. From the beginning, this company has been connected to family, purpose and legacy.

Today we formulate botanical supplements, medicinal tea blends, skincare and haircare for customers internationally. Most of our products are professionally contract manufactured, we warehouse across several countries, and our quality systems are far removed from those early handmade days. But to understand Zyzven Naturals, you first need to understand where it came from.

Shawnafi Dynesen
They didn’t make me a doctor. They made me a student.

The Journey

Thirteen chapters, one thread

From a small kitchen in St. Thomas to warehouses across five countries. Tap any chapter to read it.

01Roots in St. Thomas, JamaicaA Jamaican Maroon childhood where herbs, roots and barks were simply understood.

I am a Jamaican Maroon from St. Thomas. The Jamaican Maroons are descendants of Africans who resisted enslavement, established independent communities and preserved important elements of African culture, identity and knowledge across generations.

Growing up in rural Jamaica, herbs, roots, leaves, barks and traditional preparations were not something I discovered later through wellness culture. They were part of everyday life. My grandmother had a particularly strong influence on the way I looked at plants and traditional remedies. Knowledge was passed through observation, conversation and experience. Plants were simply something people understood.

As an adult, that early foundation was eventually joined by research and studies in Medical Herbalism. But the motivation to study health more deeply came from something much more personal.

02Before the Brand: My Own Health JourneyMenopause at twenty, PCOS and alopecia — the questions that made me a student.

My hormonal health journey began unusually early. I was diagnosed with menopause in my early twenties and later navigated PCOS, fertility difficulties, significant weight problems, pituitary tumours, alopecia and Type 2 diabetes, which I subsequently brought into remission. All of this began before there was a Zyzven Naturals shop.

I was trying to understand why my body was behaving the way it was. That meant reading, researching, questioning, making lifestyle changes and repeatedly returning to the plants and traditional knowledge I had grown up around. Those experiences did not make me a doctor. They made me a student — and that curiosity became one of the foundations of Zyzven Naturals.

Even today, when customers repeatedly bring a particular wellness concern to us, my instinct is to study it. I look at the traditional use of botanicals, available research, ingredient forms, combinations and what a responsible formulation might look like.

I hold no formal qualification in food chemistry, and I think transparency about that matters. I develop the original formulation concepts and ingredient combinations using my research, Medical Herbalism knowledge, traditional botanical understanding, lived experience and the needs repeatedly identified within our community. The formulations are then refined with our technical and manufacturing partners before commercial production.

I am the person asking: Why is this ingredient here? What is it supposed to contribute? Does the combination make sense? That remains my role in every formulation we develop.

04A Mosquito Bite & Our First ProductMade, wrapped and packed by our own hands — where it truly began.

Our then four-year-old child was badly affected by mosquito bites during a trip to Jamaica. I wanted a botanical alternative for him, so I began making one. The result was a mosquito-repellent soap. That became our first product.

There was no factory. No large formulation team. No sophisticated packaging operation. Lawrence and I made products ourselves, wrapped them and packed them by hand. Some of the early photographs show products literally being wrapped in cling film. Today those pictures make me smile, but I also treasure them because they represent where the company truly started.

05Alopecia & the Onion Oil BreakthroughA small kitchen in Jamaica, and the onion oil that changed everything.

During an extended stay in Jamaica in 2017–2018, I was experiencing alopecia. Once again, I started researching. In a small kitchen in Jamaica, I began producing an onion-based botanical oil as part of my own hair journey.

At the same time, I was documenting that journey openly on Facebook. People could actually watch what was happening. They asked what I was using. They followed the progress. Then they started asking if they could buy it. That formulation became Zyzven Naturals Onion Growth Oil — and our breakthrough product.

Customers began sharing their experiences and telling others about the oil. Over the years, they have told us about the many ways they incorporate it into their routines, including hair, scalp, skin and nail care. Word travelled. So did the bottles. And Zyzven Naturals began growing because customers kept telling other people about us.

Today, most of our products have transitioned into professional contract manufacturing. The Onion Growth Oil has not. We still make it ourselves — it remains the product that connects the modern Zyzven Naturals to that small kitchen in Jamaica.

06Alki Detox & the Move Into WellnessFrom beauty into metabolic wellness, led by what customers told us.

My own weight and metabolic journey eventually changed the company again. I had struggled for years with stubborn abdominal weight alongside my hormonal issues. I began researching botanicals for myself and eventually developed a loose-leaf formulation that became Alki Detox — another breakthrough, and one of our most successful products.

But the most important part was what customers told us after using it. People would return and talk about their weight-management journeys, digestion and general wellbeing. Some told us about changes in blood pressure or blood sugar readings they were already monitoring. Over the years, some have also told us they achieved Type 2 diabetes remission while incorporating our products into broader, medically supervised lifestyle changes.

Those are customer experiences, not promises that a supplement can treat or cure diabetes — but they encouraged much larger conversations around metabolic wellness. Soon people were asking us about blood sugar, hormones, PCOS, menopause, fertility, fibroids, weight management and men’s health. And the company changed.

Then & now
07Facebook Lives, Hormones & CommunityThe Lives that became a classroom — and “the baby factory.”

We did something else that became fundamental to Zyzven Naturals. We educated. I began hosting Facebook Lives around the subjects our customers were asking about: hormones, PCOS, menopause, fertility, weight, metabolic wellness, hair loss — the conversations people were having privately but often didn’t fully understand.

Something remarkable happened. The more we educated, the more people recognised themselves in what we were talking about. A woman would hear a conversation about hormonal symptoms and suddenly say, this sounds like me. Someone would share the Live with a sister, friend, partner or parent. Our social media became much more than somewhere to advertise — it became a community classroom.

Education created conversation. Conversation created trust. Trust created recommendations. And those recommendations built the brand.

Zyzven Naturals has never relied on paid advertising to build its customer base. Our growth has come through education, customer recommendations, word of mouth and people sharing their own experiences. Our customers became our strongest ambassadors.

The “baby factory” & creating space for menopause. Hormonal wellness gradually became one of the areas our community knew us best for. Women spoke to us about PCOS, irregular cycles, fertility difficulties and menopause. Having experienced fertility difficulties myself, those conversations were particularly close to me.

Then customers began returning with pregnancy announcements, and eventually photographs of babies. It happened often enough that our community affectionately began calling Zyzven Naturals “the baby factory.” We have never promised pregnancy — fertility is complex and our products are not fertility treatments — but hearing from so many women who chose our products as part of their wider journey became one of the most meaningful parts of building the brand.

At the same time, we deliberately created space for women to talk about menopause. For years women joined our Lives saying, nobody told me this was menopause. Those conversations eventually contributed to my book, WombWise – Womb Wisdom & The Works, a culturally aware guide to menopause and women’s wellness — designed to bring forward experiences Black and Caribbean women did not always see reflected in mainstream resources, while remaining relevant to women from all backgrounds.

Formulated for everyone, without forgetting who helped shape us. Zyzven Naturals products are for everyone, but we are particularly proud of the trust the brand has built within Black and Caribbean communities. Today our customers come from many racial, cultural and national backgrounds. Our roots explain who we are. They do not determine who is welcome.

08From Medicinal Teas to Advanced SupplementsWhere we came from, and where our customers asked us to go.

For years, medicinal loose-leaf teas were central to Zyzven Naturals. They were close to my Jamaican botanical roots and gave us the ability to create complex blends around specific wellness needs. But customers kept asking us for something else: convenience. They loved the teas, but people were working, travelling and raising families. Not everyone could brew medicinal tea every day.

That pushed us into advanced food supplements. But we did not want simply to grind raw herbs into powder, put them in capsules and call the job finished. Our objective became practitioner-strength formulations built around concentrated and standardised botanical extracts where appropriate — allowing us to work differently from raw powdered herbs, particularly where concentration and consistency in specified plant constituents matter.

Our teas represent where we came from. Our supplements represent where our customers asked us to go.

Today, our strongest formulation areas include hormonal wellness, metabolic health, women’s wellness, menopause, men’s vitality, healthy weight management and everyday wellbeing.

09From Handmade to Professional ManufacturingGMP, HACCP and BRCGS — built to scale, and transparent about it.

There was a time when Lawrence and I physically made and packed the products ourselves. Growth meant that could not remain the model for everything. Today, most Zyzven Naturals products are professionally contract manufactured through carefully selected partners, giving us greater production capacity, consistency, documentation and quality control as the company expands. Our Onion Growth Oil remains produced by us and continues to carry that direct connection to the handmade beginnings.

Our wider manufacturing and quality framework now includes, depending on the product and facility, standards and certifications such as GMP manufacturing, HACCP and BRCGS systems, third-party analytical testing, Vegan and Non-GMO specifications, and Halal and Kosher certification where applicable — with appropriately registered manufacturing facilities for the markets being served. Not every certification applies to every product, and we believe it is important to be transparent about that distinction. Our products are also covered by product liability insurance across key markets.

We may have started with cling film and a kitchen table. We never intended to stay there.

10Starting Again & Rebuilding the BrandWe have had to build this brand more than once.

I was not naturally a businessperson. I was a formulator with ideas, customers and a strong ability to connect with people. In the early years, Zyzven Naturals began gaining real momentum, including getting products onto retail shelves in Jamaica. Then life changed.

Personal circumstances and moving countries meant that much of what we had built could not simply continue in the same way. Our family moved from Sweden to the United Kingdom, and in many respects Zyzven Naturals had to start again. We rebuilt the customer base. We learned new regulations and systems. We developed new manufacturing relationships. We strengthened the products. We built new fulfilment infrastructure. We rebuilt the business itself. London became an important headquarters and international base.

Eventually, our family’s journey brought us back to Sweden. This time, however, we were not returning with the same small company that had left. We returned with experience, international customers, stronger formulations, professional manufacturing relationships, better systems and a much clearer understanding of the company we wanted to build.

We had built Zyzven Naturals once through instinct. We rebuilt it with experience. And that second foundation is much stronger.

12International From Day OneWarehoused across five countries. International was always the vision.

Even when Zyzven Naturals was small, we did not think of it as a brand that should remain limited to one town or one country. Our online community was already international. Customers shared products with relatives and friends across borders, and from very early on we approached the company with the intention of reaching an international market.

Today, Zyzven Naturals warehouses products across five countries, with online orders fulfilled through the location closest to each market — bringing products nearer to customers and building a more efficient international distribution network.

We moved from handmade production to professional manufacturing, from one physical shop to international e-commerce, from local packing to multiple fulfilment locations, and from informal word-of-mouth sales to a growing international retailer and distribution network. We did not suddenly decide to become international because the business became bigger. International was always part of the vision.

Now We Scale

Ready for the next chapter

The story of Zyzven Naturals has never been perfectly linear. We have gone from a small ethnic shop in Sweden to products made in a kitchen in Jamaica; from hair oil to medicinal teas; from Facebook Lives to conversations about hormones, fertility and menopause that brought thousands of people into our community; from handmade products to professional manufacturing; from building momentum to having to start over in another country. And then we rebuilt.

That matters because Zyzven Naturals today is not simply an idea with potential. It is a brand that has been tested by customers, by relocation, by changing markets and by the realities of building a company from the ground up. Our customer base has largely been built organically rather than through paid advertising. Our products have travelled because people talked about them.

At the same time, we have spent years strengthening what sits behind that demand: formulations, testing, manufacturing relationships, international fulfilment, brand protection and a more professional retail and distribution structure. We now warehouse across the USA, UK, Canada, Sweden and Jamaica, while continuing to develop our international reach.

Our goal now is to place Zyzven Naturals in more communities, more retail environments and more international markets while protecting the trust that built the company in the first place. We want customers to feel confident buying it, entrepreneurs and retailers to see a range they are proud to carry, distributors to see an established story and proven formulations, and strategic partners to see a founder-led company with authentic origins, organic demand, international ambition, established infrastructure and considerable room still to grow.

Zyzven Naturals began because I needed answers. It grew because other people recognised themselves in the questions. It survived because Lawrence and I were willing to rebuild it when life changed. And it continues because our customers kept believing in what we were creating strongly enough to tell someone else.

Rooted in heritage. Refined by knowledge. Formulated with purpose. Built for legacy.

Zyzven Naturals

From our family to yours — and from St. Thomas, Jamaica, to the world.

settings.title: Using the Brand to Create Opportunity
settings.body:
When COVID-19 disrupted jobs and livelihoods, I watched women around us lose income. Zyzven Naturals was still growing, but I wanted the company to become useful in another way. We began allowing women to access our products at low wholesale rates, sell them within their communities and keep the profit. That early model gave some women an opportunity during a difficult period ‚Äî but it also taught us important business lessons. An informal model is difficult to sustain as a company grows.

We learned that successful long-term partnerships need clear pricing, professional agreements, structure, boundaries, territory considerations and reliable wholesale and distribution systems. So the model evolved. Today, we are deliberately expanding structured opportunities for retailers, resellers, wellness professionals and distributors to carry Zyzven Naturals.

Building a legacy beyond our own family. Our children have grown up alongside Zyzven Naturals, and we are building something they can eventually understand, participate in and potentially carry forward. But legacy cannot only mean our own children ‚Äî a portion of Zyzven Naturals' profits supports girls' education in rural Gambia, where we are helping to fund the development of a school. Education can change what becomes possible for a girl. Entrepreneurship can change what becomes possible for a woman.
settings.mini_quote: When Zyzven Naturals grows, we want that growth to create opportunity for other people too.
